title: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A command-line Python tool that generates synthetic data from CSV or Excel files, handling PII anonymization, metadata management, and synthesizer reuse. It directly imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, and evaluate_quality to train models and score output quality.
evidence: generate_synthetic_data_gpu.py:2-4 imports CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, evaluate_quality from sdv; line 176 defines generate_synthetic_data using CTGANSynthesizer
